Figure12illustrates the performance variation curves of Llama3.1-8B trained with WEBRL on each website. It can be seen that in all the sites except for Map, there is a clear upward trend. However, in the case of Map, there is an initial upward trend followed by a decline. We hypothesize that the final decline is caused by a significant increase in OSS and CMS implementation, which creates a trade-off. This trade-off leads to a performance drop in Map and a slight decline in GitLab.
